chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Kid Ory at Newport and the Cavalcade of Jazz with Teagarden
summary: He last heard Ory at Newport, and tells again of drinking with Teagarden and playing Tiger Rag until morning before the Cavalcade of Jazz.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: What was Kid Ory's playing like that at that time? Hot Five Did you hear him with groups of Louis Armstrong?
The last time I heard Kid Ory was up at Newport with Jack Teagarden, Kid Ory, and myself. Both of them passed away since then.
Right. But you didn't hear him during the 20's when you came to New York?

No, I played with Jack Teagarden. No, he came to New York ... So we went out on a cavalcade of jazz. (Dinah?) Washington was with us and we were out for about 5 or 6 months. So every night we'd drink the same brand of whiskey. We'd have a case of Seagram's Seven and drink it every night and they played my horn... 'come on gate, let's drink' I'd say, okay
No, he'd get me out of bed. I didn't tell you that story. I was living around 138th Street. They'd get me

out of bed and Willie the Lion Smith was playing at the Nest, just piano. So O'Neil Spencer, the drummer, came and got me... I just got up and said, O.K. I've never been afraid to play with no man. I wouldn't call myself showing off when I play. I just started to play. So we played 'Tiger Rag' in 7 keys. I kept him there till 8 o'clock in the morning. That was when we went on the Cavalcade of Jazz. That's exactly when it was, Cavalcade of Jazz. Every day we sat down and drank a case of whiskey.....a quart of whiskey. And I liked him
